research.title: Baseline Prediction with Incomplete Tabular Data
bullets: Prepared tabular datasets by checking missing values, standardizing continuous variables, and fitting preprocessing transformations exclusively on training partitions.
Implemented assigned logistic regression and random forest baselines, comparing imputation strategies through held-out discrimination metrics and subgroup error summaries.

projects.title: Probability Calibration for Binary Classification
bullets: Implemented logistic regression and naive Bayes baselines in scikit-learn, using stratified splits to separate model fitting, calibration, and evaluation.
Compared uncalibrated predictions with sigmoid calibration using reliability diagrams and Brier scores, documenting sensitivity to class imbalance.
